findings.title: Keep the exported-name list out of child environments
findings.body: If the caller already exports `exported`, Bash preserves its export attribute when assigning the list. I reproduced this on Linux with 1,800 long environment names. The base loop ran the next external command successfully, while the candidate failed with `Argument list too long`. The same limit can prevent the exit trap from running `rm`, leaving the temporary directory behind.

findings.title: Record candidate-specific suite results before marking C2 fixed
findings.body: The disposition says the final full-suite run is recorded below, but only latency measurements follow. The verification table ends at `8db4ef5` and explicitly skips the code-review lanes there. A reviewer cannot verify a full-suite pass for this candidate from the cited record.

findings.title: Correct the C2 severity totals
findings.body: The summary reports five P2 findings and one P3. Both `challenge-C2.json` and the disposition table contain four P2 findings and two P3 findings, so anyone using the summary for triage will overcount P2 by one.
